author: gobernment
body:
I haven't made a map in a while, so I went Kinky.

Some map images

Map Information
Game: CTW
Server: Singleplayer
Authors: Wulfcaspice
Contributors: Xuph
Players: 8v8 (min) 12v12 (max)
Inspiration: Injustice, Rendezvous 3.5, FrozenSolstice

I probably won't touch the map much... it is how it is right now. If any mapdevs or users want to make edits, feel free to.
Download is coming soon, and XML will be made if accepted.
